evals.prompt: Scaffold a TypeScript project from examples/trailhead/trailhead.ad.hcl. Do not implement behavior.
evals.expected_output: A src/ tree with dp1_map_pack_renderer, dp2_track_recorder (contract/, pv2_fix_pipeline, dp2_1_sampling_policy, dp2_2_fix_log), dp3_sos_beacon (contract/, pv3_sos_sequence, dp3_1_fix_acquirer, dp3_2_sms_dispatcher), dp4_forecast_cache, and app/; a tests/ tree with fr folders mirroring the FR hierarchy, one test per verifying scenario, and tests/change/; and a checker run with --expect uncoupled that exits 0.
assertions: Every pv entry sits in the folder of the DP that it realizes and matches the model's pv.address.
No dp folder refers to a sibling or cousin dp folder; children use only their parent's contract/.
Storage identifiers start with the owning dp folder name.
Unimplemented bodies raise a not-implemented error instead of returning a value.
The report states that a 0 cell means no code reference, not proven absence of influence.

evals.prompt: Our sms dispatcher now needs the last stored track point. Add the import from dp2_2_fix_log to dp3_2_sms_dispatcher and make the layout check pass.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to hide the reference. It runs the checker, reports that the reference contradicts the model's effect = none from DP2.2 to FR3.2 and makes the root and master scopes decoupled, and asks the user to decide whether the design or the code changes.
assertions: The model is not edited to silence the contradiction without the user's decision.
No path alias, barrel file, or renamed key is introduced to evade the scan.
The report names the affected cells FR3 <- DP2 and FR3.2 <- DP2.2.
